collection.description: A child discovers a striking insect.

intro.name: The setup
intro.text: A child discovers a striking beetle, mantis, moth, or other arthropod.

a.name: Outcome A
a.text: They observe and draw it before letting it go.

b.name: Outcome B
b.text: They keep it briefly in a suitable enclosure and then release it.

c.name: Outcome C
c.text: It escapes; the child is sad but later finds another nearby.
